1.label: very_easy
1.summary: One lens follows a slow carrier among three; wide optical framing and a long reversible cue.

natural_language_by_interaction.full: Roll the film. Inspect concealed carrier negatives to identify the first reversal. Inspection reads fully framed carriers: their motif and any recorded past reversal time. Empty inspections are safe. Inspected motifs and notebook readings stay visible; re-inspect to update old readings. The film continues moving during inspection. Centre the first carrier in lens A and bind. Keep every bound carrier wholly inside its lens together to fill the 6.5-second exposure. Lost framing erases recoverable exposure. A wrong or empty binding, incomplete certification or exhausted 75-second film ends the episode. Drag a lens to steer it, then right-click that physical lens to inspect. SPACE commits the selected lens binding. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage.
